title: 3623. Count Number of Trapezoids I

examples.explanation: There are three distinct ways to pick four points that form a horizontal trapezoid: Using points [1,0], [2,0], [3,2], and [2,2]. Using points [2,0], [3,0], [3,2], and [2,2]. Using points [1,0], [3,0], [3,2], and [2,2].
There is only one horizontal trapezoid that can be formed.
